replacements.old:
assert review['kind'] == 'AUTHOR_ASSEMBLED_IMMUTABLE_BINDING_OF_1828_CORRECTION_COMPOSITION_AND_FIXTURE_NOT_A_NEW_REVIEW'
    assert review['verdict'] == 'BOUND_EXISTING_INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_REVIEWS_AND_EXACT_COMPOSITION_ONLY'
    assert review['owning_parent_count'] == 12
    # This authored binding is not a new independent product review. Verify
    # the actual correction report, exact automatic main composition and the
    # separately scoped one-line fixture review before controller admission.
    product_review = review['product_review']
    assert digest(product_review['path']) == product_review['sha256']
    original_review = json.loads(Path(product_review['path']).read_bytes())
    assert original_review['head'] == product_review['head']
    assert original_review['tree'] == product_review['tree']
    assert original_review['status'] == 'INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_CLEAR_CORRECTION_ONLY_EXECUTION_UNRUN'
    assert original_review['root_independent_source_review']['reviewer_is_author'] is False
    composition = review['composition_receipt']
    assert digest(composition['path']) == composition['sha256']
    composed = json.loads(Path(composition['path']).read_bytes())
    assert composed['head'] == composition['head'] and composed['tree'] == composition['tree']
    assert composed['feature_parent'] == product_review['head']
    assert composed['prior_source_review_sha256'] == product_review['sha256'] and composed['clean'] is True
    assert composed['merge'] == 'Automatic merge had no conflicts; no manual source resolution or changes after clean merge. Main supplies required script prerequisite files.'
    delta_review = review['fixture_delta_review']
    assert digest(delta_review['path']) == delta_review['sha256']
    fixture = json.loads(Path(delta_review['path']).read_bytes())
    assert fixture['head'] == plan['product_head'] and fixture['tree'] == plan['product_tree']
    assert fixture['base'] == composition['head']
    assert fixture['status'] == 'ONE_LINE_FIXTURE_CORRECTION_SOURCE_CLEAR_EXECUTION_PENDING'
    assert fixture['changed_paths'] == ['tests/check_format.py']
    assert fixture['independent_review']['verdict'] == 'SOURCE_CLEAR'
replacements.new:
assert review['kind'] == 'AUTHOR_ASSEMBLED_IMMUTABLE_PR1287_MANIFEST_STATUS_BINDING_NOT_A_NEW_REVIEW'
    assert review['verdict'] == 'BOUND_SOURCE_PLAN_AND_REPORTED_SCRIPT_STATUS_ONLY'
    assert review['owning_parent_count'] == 16
    # Authored source-plan/status binding, not an independent product review or grant.
    # The exact independent controller receipt below still owns admission review.
    manifest_ref = review['source_manifest']
    assert digest(manifest_ref['path']) == manifest_ref['sha256']
    manifest = json.loads(Path(manifest_ref['path']).read_bytes())
    assert manifest['head'] == plan['product_head'] and manifest['tree'] == plan['product_tree']
    assert manifest['queue_assignments'] == {'cli': 0, 'host': 4, 'ui': 12}
    assert manifest['source_predicted_compiled_selected_counts'] == {'cli': 0, 'host': 16, 'ui': 12}
    assert plan['source_paths_sha256'] == {path: value['sha256'] for path, value in manifest['current_leaf_pins'].items()}
    assert [group['id'] for group in plan['artifact_groups']] == ['host-lib', 'ui-lib']
    assert [group['features'] for group in plan['artifact_groups']] == [['host'], ['ui']]
    assert [check['artifact_group'] for check in plan['binary_checks']] == ['host-lib', 'ui-lib']
    for lane, group in zip(('host', 'ui'), plan['artifact_groups']):
        assert [contract['name'] for contract in group['selectors']] == manifest['lanes'][lane]['assigned_selectors']
        assert all(contract['expected_child_reexecutions'] == 0 for contract in group['selectors'])
        assert group['source_predicted_compiled_names'] == manifest['lanes'][lane]['source_predicted_compiled_selected_names']
        assert group['source_predicted_absent_names'] == manifest['lanes'][lane]['source_predicted_selected_names_absent']
    freeze_ref = review['composition_freeze']
    assert digest(freeze_ref['path']) == freeze_ref['sha256'] == manifest['freeze']['sha256']
    freeze = json.loads(Path(freeze_ref['path']).read_bytes())
    assert freeze['head'] == plan['product_head'] and freeze['tree'] == plan['product_tree']
    assert all(plan['source_paths_sha256'][path] == sha for path, sha in freeze['leaves'].items())
    status_ref = review['script_status_companion']
    assert digest(status_ref['path']) == status_ref['sha256']
    companion = json.loads(Path(status_ref['path']).read_bytes())
    assert companion['same_head'] == plan['product_head'] and companion['manifest_sha256'] == manifest_ref['sha256']
    assert companion['script_status_update']['status'] == 'COMPLETED'
    assert companion['script_status_update']['conclusion'] == 'SUCCESS'
    script_ref = review['script_success_readback']
    assert digest(script_ref['path']) == script_ref['sha256'] == companion['script_status_update']['sha256']
    script_receipt = json.loads(Path(script_ref['path']).read_bytes())
    assert script_receipt['headRefOid'] == plan['product_head']
    assert any(check.get('name') == 'Script contracts' and check.get('status') == 'COMPLETED'
               and check.get('conclusion') == 'SUCCESS' for check in script_receipt['statusCheckRollup'])

permitted_delta: Paths/source binding/pins,16-parent22-phase counts, exact source manifest/status admission metadata, and serial each-group-check orchestration plus fresh source-predicted compiled selector presence recording separate from assigned execution. No low-level launch/wait/pidfd/signal/custody/parser/negative/retention/lock-close body changed.
negative_path_ELF_hash_limit: Conserved donor limitation: ELF digest is checked before inventory/each owning parent and after invoke returns successfully. If invoke raises on nonzero/timeout/custody/source/evidence error, control never reaches that phase's post-use digest. No post-failed-use ELF hash or full ELF bytes are guaranteed archived; do not claim unchanged ELF after a failed phase. All raw negative outcomes stay nonqualifying; strict original wait/custody still governs any release.
strict_parser_limit: Exact unchanged parent_pass requires running1, exact named success,1P0F0I summary and ordinary event sequence. Filtered integer is accepted syntactically by donor; independent evidence reviewer must compare original raw summary against fresh inventory N-1. No parser broadening or child-count exception used for any selected parent.
grant_limit: A supplied --grant UUID is recorded against exact runner/plan/review/source receipts. Syntax acceptance neither verifies a fresh external cagents grant nor enforces once-only authorization. Root must obtain new actual grant for this exact packet/argv/cwd and coordinate fair admission before any execution; no current grant is present.
historical_record_scope: All direct runtime source/report dependencies are local immutable copies. Historical donor reports retain their original external reference strings solely as archived provenance; this runner never dereferences those nested historical strings or transfers old product/capacity/runtime results. Every direct archive binding has its own copied bytes/hash.
